title: Cortical processing that bypasses layer 5 neurons is unconscious

statements.text: Cortical processing that does not involve layer 5 pyramidal neurons, or whose apical modulation stays too weak, does not reach the nonspecific thalamus and is not conscious. Feedforward processing that flows within the superficial layers and bypasses thalamocortical neurons is unconscious.
statements.falsification_criteria: Conscious content shown to depend on cortical processing that engages neither layer 5 pyramidal neurons nor the nonspecific thalamus.

sources.quote: cortical processing that does not include L5p neurons will be unconscious
we make the strong prediction that cortical processing in itself, when not integrated with the NSP thalamic nuclei via L5p neurons, is not conscious
